logical_reasoning.question: A team of four developers completes a task in 12 days. How many days will eight equally productive developers take?
logical_reasoning.answer: The total work is 48 developer-days. Eight developers will require 6 days.

logical_reasoning.question: A sequence is 2, 6, 12, 20, 30. What is the next number?
logical_reasoning.answer: 42. The differences are 4, 6, 8 and 10, so the next difference is 12.

scenario_evaluation.question: A production application fails after a new deployment. How would you respond?
scenario_evaluation.answer: I would first assess the impact and check monitoring alerts and application logs. I would identify the affected service and compare the latest deployment changes. If the issue affects users significantly, I would coordinate a rollback while investigating the root cause. After fixing it, I would test the solution and document the incident.
